  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "r:5114081037",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "test flakiness and false failures when a second rollover occurs between setting now and client idle stamping",
      "quote": "now is a whole second, taken before the clients exist and compared against an m_idle_since they stamp later, so the checks expecting a disconnect at now + timeout + 1s only hold while both fall in the",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author mocked and froze the clock to eliminate the second rollover window",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5122740083"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5122740083",
      "status_by_quote": "Opted for mocking the clock and freeze it rather than trying to keep up with the current time of the actual clock as it "
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3934900193",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "accepted connections that send nothing prevent fast shutdown or exhaust RPC slots when -rpcservertimeout=0",
      "quote": "A connection that is accepted and never sends anything keeps m_connection_busy at its initial true, so the disconnect_all branch never picks it up. Inside ShouldDisconnect() only the idle timeout is l",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer agreed the idle connection behavior belongs in a follow-up",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3941825335"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3942255601",
      "status_by_quote": "Agreed it does not belong here though, and your five seconds sounds like the right direction. Happy to open a follow-up."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3934900157",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "use ZeroSock directly instead of a custom socket setup in test",
      "quote": "ZeroSock::Send() already returns len, so could this just be a ZeroSock?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "addressed in push 352fdc27",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5122740083"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5122740083",
      "status_by_quote": "Addressed all of it to some extent in the latest push (352fdc279751694348c6b406322de5582f59ad49)"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3934900200",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "add a test case for an HTTP/1.1 keep-alive client so the persistent connection branch is exercised",
      "quote": "Replacing that condition with false leaves this test green. Worth one more client?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "addressed in push 352fdc27",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5122740083"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5122740083",
      "status_by_quote": "Addressed all of it to some extent in the latest push (352fdc279751694348c6b406322de5582f59ad49)"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4095518233",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "remove the comment or clarify that keep-alive clients get dropped here during shutdown",
      "quote": "I think this comment can just be removed or something added to the above comment that this is where even keep-alive clients get dropped, because we are shutting down.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author addressed comment improvements in push 2abf671d",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6024255163"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6024255163",
      "status_by_quote": "applied your neat nits. Also attempted to improve some comments."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4096297781",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "move the disconnect logging into the lambda to allow ShouldDisconnect() to use return statements",
      "quote": "move the Log(\"Disconnecting client...\") here inside the lambda. Then `ShouldDisconnect()` could be clarified by filling those blank spaces with `return` statements",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author applied suggestion in push 2abf671d",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6024255163"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6024255163",
      "status_by_quote": "applied your neat nits. Also attempted to improve some comments."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5114081037",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Built the four commits and mutation-tested the changed branches.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": []
    },

      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5306713554",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "Built and tested on macos/arm64. Reviewed the changes and checked with both meatball brain and LLM that the refactor didn't change behavior. Great new text coverage helps with that a lot as well.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "review of push 2abf671d addressing pinheadmz's review suggestions",
      "id": "c:6024255163"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added sedited to participants after asking about addressing review nits. Updated pinheadmz's suggestions to fixed after hodlinator pushed 2abf671d."
}
